name: Maintenance - Preventive and corrective maintenance
description: Verifies maintenance management: creating maintenance tasks, scheduling, tracking completion, and calendar view

planSteps.description: Assert that maintenance dashboard shows both list and calendar views
Click 'New Maintenance' and select type (preventive or corrective)
Fill in: asset/equipment selection, description, priority, scheduled date, assigned technician
Submit and verify the maintenance task is created with 'scheduled' status
Navigate to /dashboard/maintenance/schedules to view the calendar with FullCalendar integration
Assert that the new maintenance task appears on the calendar on the correct date
Mark the maintenance task as 'completed' with completion notes and verify status update
